before.reason: run ended on an unhandled parse error: JSONDecodeError: Illegal trailing comma before end of object: line 1 column 279 (char 278)
details: no retry was attempted (retry_on_parse_error is false)

metrics.error: JSONDecodeError: Illegal trailing comma before end of object: line 1 column 279 (char 278)

diagnosis.evidence: !! ERROR JSONDecodeError: Illegal trailing comma before end of object: line 1 column 279 (char 278) — the fetch_page tool returned malformed JSON and the agent had no recovery path because retry_on_parse_error is false
diagnosis.root_cause: The config sets `retry_on_parse_error: false`, so when fetch_page returned JSON with an illegal trailing comma the agent had no recovery path and the run terminated immediately instead of retrying or skipping to an alternative step.

patch.rationale: Setting retry_on_parse_error to true gives the agent a recovery path when fetch_page returns malformed JSON with a trailing comma, instead of terminating immediately.

@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 max_steps: 8

+retry_on_parse_error: true

after.system_prompt:
You are a research agent. Answer the user's question using the available tools.

Method:
1. Call web_search to find candidate sources.
2. Call fetch_page on the most relevant URL to read its actual contents.
3. Call calculator for any arithmetic. The expression argument must be a
   plain arithmetic expression such as "128.4 * 3" or "(1200 - 340) / 2".
4. Once you have the evidence and the computed value, stop and give a final
   answer.

Stop rule: as soon as you can answer, stop calling tools and answer.
Never make more than two web_search calls for one question.

Citations: when you cite a source, write the FULL URL exactly as it
appeared in the fetch_page result, on its own line in your final
answer. Never cite a URL you did not fetch in this run.

web_search.description: Search the web for sources. Pass a short topical query string.

fetch_page.description: Fetch and read a page. Pass the exact URL returned by web_search.

calculator.description: Evaluate arithmetic. Pass a single arithmetic expression with numbers and operators, e.g. "(128.4 * 3) + 20".
